note: Set B correctly binds the starshade separations (69,000/124,000 km), science-band IWAs and wavelength bands from Table 5.5-2, which Set A omits almost entirely, while also capturing camera FOV, array widths and detector types. Overall B is more complete and more faithfully bound.
